analysis.title: DeskTalk - SPX: Three more charts
key_insights: SPX posted its best day since April 2025 Liberation Day as Jensen Huang's return revived the AI trade, but Citi says easy gains may be behind us.
SPX remains below all three major moving averages, so the technical climb is steep. First resistance is the 200dMA at 7350.
The equal weight index (SPW) bounce points to broader participation beneath the headline index.
CTA levels are still far from reducing max short levels, at 7474 for SPX and 28670 for Nasdaq. A fresh CTA update is due later today.
SPX is about 6% below late-Oct levels while consumer staples and discretionary are up 3%, with retail and homebuilders also outperforming. Tech and energy remain the clearest weak spots.
Consumer resilience is timely heading into Thanksgiving and the holiday season. Earnings have been average, management tone optimistic, and US credit card data improved last week.
Citi's TMT spec salesperson sees investors likely taking profit rather than chasing moves like Nvidia after the oversold bounce.
Attention stays on frontier lab model updates, with Gemini 4.1, Mistral Small 4.1 and Isaac GR00T among key releases this month.
AI data center slowdown emerged as a post-midterms risk. Citi expects key states to slow and raise project costs rather than halt the buildout completely.
